title: Connector relay: HTTP streams, flow control, decisions
description: HTTP request and response frames per chat, derived from the portal's streamed proxy (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/portal/proxy.js proxyHttp, forwardHeaders, FORWARD, responseHeaders, HOP_BY_HOP; identical on web-chat-dev main; these move to the shared lib/relay, contract 05 section 4) with the viewer's socket replaced by link frames. The connector keeps the hop to 127.0.0.1:<port>, which the hub never learns.

request.description: One HTTP request for a chat's daemon (C-05.28 to C-05.31), as lib/portal/proxy.js proxyHttp sends one upstream: method, path with query, the allowlisted headers, the body streamed. Direction: hub to connector.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

stream.description: The relay stream, minted by the hub, unique per connection. One HTTP exchange or one WebSocket is one stream.

chat.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its `cht_` prefix, 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters, so that `chat-<label>.<hub>` and `chat-<label>-a.<hub>` are literal. Every 05 frame and every 06 body names a chat by its label; the hub records the id.

surface.description: session: the daemon's main port, for chat-<label>.<hub>. answer: its answer surface, for chat-<label>-a.<hub>; the connector finds its port as a host caller with GET /api/asks?ensure=1 (lib/portal/answer.js).

method.description: The method. OPTIONS is answered by the hub and never relayed (nothing on the daemon answers a preflight, by design: lib/server/routes/queue.js writeGuard).

path.description: Path and query exactly as the viewer sent them. Never one under /__swc/ (contract 03, C-03.10).

headers.description: The viewer's headers after the hub's own filter: only lib/portal/proxy.js FORWARD names, sec-fetch-*, origin (only once the hub matched it against the chat's origin) and, toward the answer surface only, x-wc-answer. The connector filters again (C-05.30).

actor.description: The X-WC-Actor value for this request, built by the hub and copied verbatim by the connector (contract 03, C-03.19 to C-03.21). The connector never builds, alters or reuses one.

decision.description: The current policy decision for this principal on this chat (contract 04, C-04.8). The connector stamps X-WC-Level, X-WC-Grants and X-WC-Decision from it and gates the route with it.

decision_ref.description: Instead of `decision`: a decision the hub already sent on this connection in a relay.decision frame (C-05.31).

device.description: The viewer's device class as the hub saw it. Informative: the daemon's own push provenance comes from the request (lib/server/domain/queue.js provenance).

body.description: Body bytes, standard base64, at most 262144 bytes decoded per frame.

end.description: True when `body` (or no body) is the whole request body; false when relay.http.body frames follow.

response.description: The daemon's status and headers (C-05.32): what lib/portal/proxy.js responseHeaders receives, minus hop-by-hop names and set-cookie, with responseHeaders applied by the connector, plus contract 06's downstream set. The hub adds no security header. Direction: connector to hub.

status.description: The daemon's status; or the connector's own: 403 with contract 04's refusal body, 404 for a chat not running here with the connector's own body {ok: false, connector: true, reason: 'not-running'}, which contract 10 maps as the connector's not_found, never the daemon's (C-05.30), 502 with the portal's NOT_ANSWERING body (lib/portal/index.js) when the daemon did not answer.

headers.description: Response headers as the connector built them (C-05.32): lib/portal/proxy.js responseHeaders (proxy.js:125-150: referrer policy, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, no-store, frame-ancestors) applied with contract 06's embed ancestors (C-06.31), contract 06's downstream rules (06-relay-headers.json downstream_response), contract 04's x-wc-answer-origin and, on a relayed GET /api/health in embedded mode, x-wc-embedded and x-wc-embed-parent (contract 06 decides the form).

end.description: True when this frame ends the response.

body.description: More body bytes for a stream, either direction (C-05.33). Streamed end to end: an SSE response or an export flows chunk by chunk, never buffered whole. Direction: both directions.
